question_text: This scatter diagram shows the age and annual income of 10 randomly chosen individuals. The mean age is 27 and the mean income is $40 000.

subparts.stem: Describe the relationship between the age and annual income for these individuals.
subparts.solution: There is a strong, positive correlation between the age of an individual and their annual income.

ai_explanation.concept_rule: Correlation direction is positive when both variables increase together; points closely clustered around a line indicate strong correlation.
step_by_step: Observe that as age increases, income generally increases.
Identify that the points follow a clear upward linear trend with little spread.
ai_explanation.common_pitfalls: Omitting either the strength or direction of the correlation.

subparts.stem: Do you think there is a causal relationship between the variables? Explain your answer.
subparts.solution: No, the relationship is more likely dependent on the amount of professional experience or qualifications an individual has.

ai_explanation.concept_rule: A causal relationship requires that one variable directly causes change in the other without relying on a third variable.
step_by_step: Determine if simply getting older causes a higher income.
Note that experience, promotions, and career progression are the true direct causes.

subparts.stem: Draw a line of best fit by eye on the graph.
subparts.final_answer: $Mean point $(27, 40)$ plotted with line of best fit$

mark_breakdown.desc: Drawing a straight line of best fit through the mean point

subparts.solution: Calculate or locate the mean point $(\bar{x}, \bar{y}) = (27, 40)$. Plot this point on the scatter plot and draw the line of best fit passing through it and following the trend of the data.

ai_explanation.concept_rule: The line of best fit by eye must pass through the mean point $(\bar{x}, \bar{y})$.
step_by_step: Draw a straight line through this point that balances data points evenly on either side.
ai_explanation.common_pitfalls: Drawing a line of best fit that does not pass through the mean point.

subparts.stem: Estimate the annual income for someone who is 30 years old. Comment on the reliability of your estimate.

mark_breakdown.desc: Reading value from the line of best fit at x = 30
Correct income value with units and statement of reliability

subparts.solution: When $x = 30$, read from the line of best fit: $y \approx 45$. The annual income of someone who is 30 years old is approximately $\$45\,000$. This is an interpolation, so the estimate is reliable.

ai_explanation.concept_rule: Estimating values within the range of observed data is interpolation and is generally reliable.
step_by_step: Move vertically up to intersect the line of best fit.
State that since 30 lies within the data range (interpolation), it is reliable.
